title: Attiéké with Fish
description: Attiéké with Fish is a Côte d'Ivoire classic prepared with cassava flakes (gari), tilapia, garlic, lemon juice. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. Preprocessed gari is used instead of authentic fermented attiéké granules; the texture is not identical.

steps.instruction: Rehydrate the ready-prepared gari with water and steam briefly until fluffy; this does not duplicate traditional attiéké fermentation.
Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 25 minutes.
Grill over medium-high heat for about 19 minutes, turning regularly until charred outside and safely cooked inside.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
